title: Sparse + delta ordering: decrypt → decompress → patch → sparse reconstruction
description: Cross-feature vector validating the required transform ordering when both a patch (STORE_PATCH) and sparse map are present. The sparse map describes the fully reconstructed logical payload AFTER patch application, not the patch bytes. Transform order: FEC/repair → decrypt → decompress → patch → sparse reconstruction.
notes: The sparse map applies to the post-patch logical data, not the patch bytes.
This vector documents the required transform ordering invariant.
